Status.note: EIA-860M for September 2026: plant 1702, generator 3, status OP, nameplate 692.5 MW, operating year 1975, no planned retirement date listed. This matches GEM, so no change is proposed.

Planned retire.note: A Michigan Public Service Commission news release from June 2022 at https://www.michigan.gov/mpsc/commission/news-releases/2022/06/23/mpsc-approves-consumers-irp_takes-steps-improve-capacity says Karn units 3 and 4, which run on natural gas and fuel oil, would continue operating through May 2031. GEM already shows 2031, so this is a re-check that supports it. Consumers' 2026 plan summary at https://www.consumersenergy.com/-/media/CE/Documents/company/IRP-2026-Exec-Summary.pdf proposes new gas capacity of 456 MW at Karn in service in 2031. It does not state the retirement date of units 3 and 4, and the EIA table lists no planned retirement. A September 2026 Detroit News article reportedly says the units are earmarked for decommissioning in 2031 could not be read because it is paywalled.

units.notes: The unit is still operating. The 2031 planned retirement is still the date in the approved 2022 plan. I did not find the 2026 plan filing text that restates the date, and found no federal emergency order keeping Karn units 3 and 4 open. No turbine maker was found since this is a steam unit and no permit in the index named one.
